 사진 확대 ‘2026 MAMA.’ Photo: Screenshot from Mnet’s YouTube channel Actress Kim Hye-soo took the stage as a special presenter for 2026 MAMA AWARDS.
 Chapter 1 of the global K-pop awards ceremony 2026 MAMA AWARDS (2026 MAMA Awards) took place at 6 p.m. on the 20th at Kyocera Dome Osaka in Japan.
 Kim Hye-soo, who took the stage as a special presenter that day, said, “We always draw strength from music for healing and comfort. That’s why I came back to MAMA,” adding, “This year, I’ve come with an even more special story. Music Interstellar—the name alone makes my heart swell.”
 She continued, “From where I stand right now, each and every one of you shines like a twinkling star. I hope that in this moment, you too can enjoy what is truly you and find what you want with music as your friend, and that at the end of that journey, you’ll meet the brightest star within me.”
 The concept of 2026 MAMA AWARDS is “Music Interstellar (A MUSIC INTERSTELLAR).” It depicts a journey that transcends the boundaries of time and space, generations and tastes, as people drift among the stars of music, discovering and sharing music from different eras. The awards ceremony is being livestreamed around the world through major digital platforms, including Mnet Plus.
 [Lee Da-gyeom, Star Today reporter]
